Precise local painted violin crop edit. Retain exact framing, orange wood, violin right outer contour and blue green background. ONLY reverse dark curved f-hole horizontally INSIDE violin wood: upper round curl should open toward right rather than left, lower curl towardleft rather thanright. Keep its same size and verticalposition. Do not mirror entireimage or change violinoutline. Nativecrop47x66 can outputlarger sameaspect then resized.

Edit attached small violin detail. Replace ONLY the entire black f-shaped soundhole with ONE narrow straight dark vertical soundhole, an elongated simple oval slot without any curls. Remove both scrolls; retain orange painted wood and violin contour, exact framing and background. This is deliberate strange straight soundhole, not normal f-hole.

Edit this crop of raccoon ear under straw hat. Keep ear EXACTLY rounded same outline/size/material, hat and white ribbon native painted finish. ONLY change spatial overlap: extend the WHITE HAT RIBBON diagonally downward-right ACROSS THE MIDDLE OF THE BLACK EAR, ribbon clearly lies in front, black ear visible above AND below it. Retain hatbrim elsewhere. No earshape/anatomychanges. Samecropframing.
